description: Floor modulo (result has the sign of the divisor) from the truncating C remainder
notes: Same semantics as Java Math.floorMod and Python %; function written by us. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake: srem + 2 icmp + 2 select + add, 8 IR instructions. Division by zero and INT_MIN % -1 are UB in the source. Related report with a different formulation and int8 operands: llvm/llvm-project#205500. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
